card.line: Abel-meholah was a city in the Jordan valley, best known as the hometown of Elisha, whom God chose to become the prophet after Elijah.

moments.title: The Midianites flee
moments.text: When Gideon's three hundred men sounded their horns, the LORD set the Midianites against one another. Their army ran as far as the border of Abel-meholah.

moments.title: Part of Solomon's district
moments.text: Abel-meholah was named as the edge of a district run by Baana son of Ahilud, one of Solomon's officers.

moments.title: Elisha is chosen
moments.text: The LORD told Elijah to anoint Elisha from Abel-meholah as the next prophet. Elijah found Elisha plowing and threw his cloak around him.

moments.title: Elisha follows Elijah
moments.text: Elisha said goodbye to his family, slaughtered his pair of oxen, and cooked the meat for the people. Then he left to follow and serve Elijah.
